reason: A slow encounter with the young world seems a useful way to follow its growth and interior.
expectation: The smaller body may merge with the world, adding mass and possibly heat; the outcome is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The fast stones could show how a small body shatters, but I chose to follow the growing world first.

effect: The smaller body added mass and heat to the same tracked world, so I can continue following it.
reaction: The outcome was predictable but satisfying progress.
reason: A larger impact should advance the goal of following the world's interior and surface.
expectation: The large impact may heat and damage the world substantially, though its exact effects are uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The fast stones could reveal the shattered small body's fate, but I want to follow the world first.

reaction: The distinction between an impactor and heat clarified the physical process.
reason: Combining the molten world with metal-rich fragments may advance its interior evolution.
expectation: The fragments may add metal to the world, potentially affecting its interior; I’m unsure how.

reaction: The explanation of denser metal sinking made the interior change clear.
reason: Fast stones striking the world may reveal what happens to its surface.
expectation: The impacts may leave a battered or cratered surface, though the exact result is uncertain.

reaction: The sequence clearly connected the world's interior evolution to its later surface.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and fast impacts may shatter a small rocky body.
expectation: A fast stone will likely break a member of the rocky population into fragments that can later gather.

effect: The fast impact shattered a smaller body, leaving fragments to follow toward the remaining goal.
reaction: The contrast with cratering the larger world made the different outcomes clear.
reason: This is the only offered combination and may gather the fragments around another small body.

effect: The shattered fragments and slow incoming body formed a gravitationally bound rubble world, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: The idea that a coherent small world can remain a loose aggregate was a satisfying conclusion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the molten world as dense metal sank made its layered interior understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial slow collision was predictable, though it moved the world’s story forward.

surprise.text: The contrast between cratering the larger world and shattering a smaller body clarified how impacts can have different outcomes.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the offered combinations had clear connections to the goals.

continue.text: I would continue: the contrasting impact outcomes and rubble-world ending made me curious about what happens next.
